I’m Truc. I help energy developers, investors, and manufacturers understand and manage their **environmental, social, and climate risks**, from wind farms in Vietnam and beyond. I’m passionate about using R and QGIS to build decision-making tools that turn complex environmental data into clear, actionable insights.

## What I do

::: {.service-grid}
::: {.service-card}
### Environmental & Social Impact Assessment
ESIA and ESMP for wind, solar, gas and LNG-to-power projects, aligned with IFC Performance Standards, ADB Safeguards and Equator Principles (EP4).
:::
::: {.service-card}
### Due Diligence & ESG
ESDD, ESG DD and EHS DD for M&A transactions and manufacturing assets, turning site findings into clear, investment-ready action plans.
:::
::: {.service-card}
### Climate & Carbon
GHG inventories (GHG Protocol), climate change risk/impact assessment assessments (TCFD), CSRD/ESRS baselines, and carbon footprint analysis with R and GIS.
:::
:::

Based in **Warsaw, Poland** · MSc in Sustainable Development · MEng in Environmental Engineering.
